# L&S Consulting (Pty) Ltd

> Consulting structural and civil engineers based in Sandton, Johannesburg, South Africa. Founded in 1954 in Cape Town as Liebenberg & Stander Consulting Engineers; named L&S Consulting (Pty) Ltd since 2005. Director-owned, with a staff complement of 36 including sixteen engineers. Verified B-BBEE level four (4) contributor.

Contact: +27 11 463 4020 · mail@lsgauteng.co.za · 1st floor, Building B, Monte Circle, 178 Montecasino Blvd, Magaliessig, Sandton, 2191

## Services
- Design of structures for shopping centres, offices, hotels, warehouses, motor dealerships and similar buildings
- Design of bulk excavations, roads, paving, stormwater, sewers, water reticulation and other civil engineering works
- CAD design and modelling (AutoCAD, Revit Structure, TechnoCAD); analysis in Prokon and ETABS
- On-site construction monitoring and quality control; structural reports for insurance purposes
